mapper.sql: r.id as registrationId, r.owner_type as ownerType, r.owner_id as ownerId, #{snapshot.topicId} as sourceTopicId, r.order_num as orderQuantity, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.payment_status as paymentStatus, r.verification_status as verificationStatus, case r.purchase_kind when 1 then 'GUIDED_TICKET' when 2 then 'SELF_PLAY_PASS' when 3 then 'EXPLORE_PASS' else null end as purchaseKind, r.payable_amount as eligibleSalesSnapshot, case when ticket.id is not null then true else false end as ticketOwnerMatches, ticket.start_time as fulfillmentStartInclusive, ticket.end_time as fulfillmentEndExclusive, case when #{snapshot.scopeType} = 'TOPIC' and #{snapshot.scopeId} = #{snapshot.topicId} then true when #{snapshot.scopeType} = 'NODE' and exists ( select 1 from cms_topic_node n where n.id = #{snapshot.scopeId} and n.topic_id = #{snapshot.topicId}) then true when #{snapshot.scopeType} = 'ACTIVITY' and r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{snapshot.scopeId} then true else false end as scopeCovered, exists (select 1 from coop_group_member_verify gm where ) as organizerScopeCovered, exists (select 1 from cms_registration_scan scan where ) as merchantScanPresent, (select min(scan.create_time) from cms_registration_scan scan where ) as merchantScanTime, exists (select 1 from coop_group_member_verify gm join coop_group_verify gv on gv.activity_id = gm.activity_id where ) as groupEvidenceMatchesOrder, (select min(gv.verify_time) from coop_group_member_verify gm join coop_group_verify gv on gv.activity_id = gm.activity_id where ) as groupVerifyTime, (select min(gm.verify_time) from coop_group_member_verify gm where ) as groupMemberVerifyTime, r.verification_time as verificationTime

left join oms_ticket ticket on ticket.id = r.ticket_id and ticket.owner_type = r.owner_type and ticket.owner_id = r.owner_id and ticket.del_flag = 0 and ((r.purchase_kind = 1 and ticket.mode = 1 and ticket.sub_type = 'guided') or (r.purchase_kind = 2 and ticket.mode = 1 and ticket.sub_type = 'self') or (r.purchase_kind = 3 and ticket.mode = 2))
mapper.select: select from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{snapshot.topicId} for update

select r.id, r.owner_type as ownerType, r.owner_id as ownerId, r.member_id as memberId, r.payment_status as paymentStatus, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.verification_status as verificationStatus, r.payable_amount as payableAmount, r.owner_id as topicId from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{topicId} order by r.id for update

select r.id, r.owner_type as ownerType, r.owner_id as ownerId, r.member_id as memberId, r.payment_status as paymentStatus, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.verification_status as verificationStatus, r.payable_amount as payableAmount, a.topic_id as topicId from cms_activity a join cms_registration r on r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id where a.topic_id = #{topicId} order by r.id for update

select refund.id from refund_application refund join cms_registration r on refund.source_type = 'registration' and refund.source_id = r.id where refund.del_flag = 0 and r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{topicId} and refund.status in (0, 1) for update
